connectDone.title: Your request is with Sarvakali
connectDone.text: Sarvakali reads every request personally and will reply by email, usually within a day or two, with one of your times or another that suits.
connectDone.cleared: Your list went with your request, so it has been cleared on this device.
connectDone.error: Your request could not be sent just now. Please try again in a moment; nothing you wrote has been lost.

booking.zone: Times are shown in your time zone: {zone}.
booking.requestedText: Sarvakali will reply by email with one of your times, or another that suits. You can come back to this page at any time.
booking.proposedText: Sarvakali has offered the times below. Choose the one that suits you and it is confirmed straight away.
booking.suggestText: Offer up to three times that would suit you, and Sarvakali will reply.
booking.confirmedText: Your conversation is confirmed. The link to join is below, and in your email.
booking.linkSoon: The link to join will be sent before the call.
booking.cancelConfirm: Cancel the conversation? Sarvakali will be told.
booking.completedText: This conversation has taken place. To arrange another, send a new request.
booking.cancelledText: This conversation was cancelled. You are always welcome to send a new request.
booking.declinedTitle: Sarvakali could not take this request
booking.declinedText: Sarvakali has replied by email. You are always welcome to write again.
booking.notFound: This link does not open a booking. Please use the link in your email, or send a new request.

invoice.payText: Scan the code with any UPI app, or on your phone tap the button to open your UPI app with the amount filled in.
invoice.claimText: Tell Sarvakali you have paid, with the reference your UPI app shows (the UTR), so the payment can be matched.
invoice.claimed: Thank you. Sarvakali will check the payment and mark this invoice paid.
invoice.void: This invoice has been cancelled. Nothing is owed on it.
invoice.notFound: This link does not open an invoice. Please use the link in your email.

emails.footer: This email is about your conversation with Sarvakali. Reply to it to write to Sarvakali directly.
emails.receivedText: Thank you for writing. Your request has arrived, and Sarvakali will reply personally, usually within a day or two, with one of your times or another that suits.
emails.proposedText: Sarvakali has replied to your request and offered the times below. Choose the one that suits you, and it is confirmed straight away.
emails.manage: Need another time, or need to cancel? Use your booking page.
emails.declinedText: Thank you for writing to Sarvakali.
emails.reminderText: A gentle reminder of your conversation with Sarvakali.
emails.invoiceText: Thank you. Your invoice is ready. You can pay it by UPI from the invoice page.
emails.invoiceReminderText: A gentle reminder that this invoice is still open.
emails.receiptText: Thank you. Your payment has been received and the invoice is marked paid.
